newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 741,200 MT were one-half higher than the previous week and 23 percent above the 4-week average. Japan (398,400 MT, activity reflects 358,600 new sales, 46,400 destination changes, 6,500 cancellations) was the principal buyer. Other significant activity were reported for the Dominican Republic (69,800 MT), Egypt (67,400 MT, reflects 7,400 new sales, 60,000 destination changes), Mexico (57,300 MT), and unknown destinations (53,400 MT).
Sales activity of 240,000 MT for the 1997/98 marketing year were all for unknown destinations.

Exports of 716,400 MT were 9 percent over the prior week, but 16 percent below the 4-week average. Japan (285,600 MT) was the leading destination, followed by Taiwan (89,900 MT), the Dominican Republic (69,200 MT), and Egypt (67,400 MT).
